	<p>Being accepted into a top college comes down to how you market yourself as an applicant. All of our admission consultants are Former College Admissions Officers and they work with our college applicants to craft <strong>Strategic Positioning Narratives</strong> and personal statements that best address their unique backgrounds, interests, and how they will contribute to the college to which they apply.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Our admission consultants advise on how to best position the college application so as to match it with what each college desires to see in its students.   function formatPhoneE164(phone) {
  if (!phone) return '';

  var cleaned = phone.replace(/[^\d+]/g, '');

  if (cleaned.charAt(0) === '+') {
    return cleaned;
  }

  var digits = cleaned.replace(/\D/g, '');

  if (digits.length === 10) {
    return '+1' + digits;
  }

  if (digits.length === 11 && digits.charAt(0) === '1') {
    return '+' + digits;
  }

  return '';
}
	
  function saveLeadData(config) {
    try {
      var firstNameEl = document.querySelector(config.firstName);
      var lastNameEl = document.querySelector(config.lastName);
      var emailEl = document.querySelector(config.email);
      var phoneEl = document.querySelector(config.phone);

      var leadData = {
        first_name: firstNameEl ? firstNameEl.value.trim() : '',
        last_name: lastNameEl ? lastNameEl.value.trim() : '',
        email: emailEl ? emailEl.value.trim() : '',
        phone_number: formatPhoneE164(phoneEl ? phoneEl.value.trim() : '')
      };

      sessionStorage.setItem('gf_lead_data', JSON.stringify(leadData));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('Lead capture error:', e);
    }
  }

  Object.keys(formConfigs).forEach(function(formId) {
    var config = formConfigs[formId];
    var form = document.querySelector(config.formSelector);
    var submitButton = document.querySelector(config.submitSelector);

    if (submitButton) {
      submitButton.addEventListener('click', function () {
        saveLeadData(config);
      }, true);
    }

    if (form) {
      form.addEventListener('submit', function () {
        saveLeadData(config);
      }, true);
    }
  });
